name: A Physicist’s Dive into Cell Biology
description: Materials and typical length- and timescales in cell and organisms; structure and function of various cellular components; phenomenological growth laws; random walks and two-state systems; ligand-receptor binding (cooperativity, competitive binding); modeling of role of noise in biological systems (chemical reactions, chemotaxis, regulation of gene expression), thermodynamics of biological macromolecules; biomembrane structure, elasticity, and fluidity; modeling and simulations of interaction of biological macromolecules with biomembranes.
